history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Massachusetts enacts the LOOK Act (Ch. 138 of the Acts of 2017)
history.description: An Act Relative to Language Opportunity for Our Kids (LOOK Act) repealed the 2002 English-only mandate and authorized districts to choose program models including dual language, two-way immersion, transitional bilingual, SEI, and other research-based approaches. The act also authorized the State Seal of Biliteracy and codified the SEI endorsement framework binding core-academic teachers of ELs (later operationalized at 603 CMR 7.14(1)).

history.title: Massachusetts authorizes State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: The LOOK Act simultaneously authorized the Massachusetts State Seal of Biliteracy. DESE administers the credential for high-school graduates demonstrating proficiency in English plus one or more world languages.

history.title: SEI endorsement requirement extended to vocational educators
history.description: Effective 2021-07-01, MA DESE extended the SEI endorsement requirement (already binding on core-academic teachers and administrators of ELs) to vocational educators serving ELs. This expanded the operative scope of `sei.mandatedForAllTeachers = true` in MA without changing the underlying coding.

history.title: Re-verified against current DESE sources
history.description: Bilingual reclassified standalone → add-on; ESL reclassified add-on → standalone (DESE lists Bilingual only as an endorsement and ESL as an Academic PreK-12 license). SEI mandate scope confirmed extended to vocational educators effective July 2021 under the LOOK Act. elPercent updated 10.0 → 10.5 (NCES fall 2021).
